outputs.Decision_and_explanation: PASS - Panel A is a macroscopic photograph of intestine with no quantitative plot, so error bars are not applicable.
PASS - Panel B shows histology images, no error bars applicable.

FAIL - The upper graph in panel C is a box-and-whisker plot (box with median line and whiskers) of total polyp number per mouse across genotypes. The caption only states 'The mean numbers and sizes of intestinal polyps... (n=8-18 per genotype). *P<0.05; ***P<0.001' but never explains what the box bounds (e.g., quartiles) or whiskers (e.g., min/max, 1.5xIQR) represent, nor whether the center line is median or mean.
PASS - Panel D is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve, which does not use error bars.

FAIL - The bar graph of 'GTP-bound form' (Rac1/Cdc42) shows error bars on the bars, but the caption for panel E only describes the pulldown/immunoblotting method and does not state what the error bars represent (e.g., SD, SEM, range) or the number of replicates.
PASS - Panel F shows immunohistochemistry images, no error bars applicable.

FAIL - The 'Relative expression' bar graph (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) includes error bars and significance asterisks, but the caption for panel G describes only the immunoblotting/zymography methods and does not define what the error bars represent or report the number of replicates used to compute them.
